name: Uncommon Outbound Kerberos Connection - Security
description: Detects uncommon outbound network activity via Kerberos default port indicating possible lateral movement or first stage PrivEsc via delegation.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Web Browsers and third party application might generate similar activity. An initial baseline is required.
query: winlog.channel:Security AND ((event.code:5156 AND destination.port:88) AND (NOT ((process.executable:(\\device\\harddiskvolume* OR C\:*)) AND process.executable:*\\Windows\\System32\\lsass.exe)) AND (NOT (((process.executable:(\\device\\harddiskvolume* OR C\:*)) AND (process.executable:(*\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe OR *\\Program\ Files\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe))) OR ((process.executable:(\\device\\harddiskvolume* OR C\:*)) AND (process.executable:(*\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Mozilla\ Firefox\\firefox.exe OR *\\Program\ Files\\Mozilla\ Firefox\\firefox.exe))) OR process.executable:*\\tomcat\\bin\\tomcat8.exe)))
